text:
maria: kicking off a kv-cache x batching matrix run across FP8 / INT8 / AWQ-GPTQ variants. goal: understand accuracy delta + tail latency tradeoffs for chat vs web workloads. storing artifacts under s3://redwood-ml/experiments/kv-batch/1865432199

tony: +1. what's the matrix exactly? batch sizes, prefetch TTLs, and prefix lengths?

maria: matrix: workloads=[chat, web-search], models=[gpt-3.5-variant (fp32 baseline), fp8-quant, int8-gptq, awq], batch_sizes=[1,4,8,16], kvcache_prefix=[0,32,128], prefetch_ttl_ms=[0,50,200]. each cell will run 2k samples for accuracy/regression evals and 30m steady-state for latency/cost.

sanjay: nice. can we prioritize the chat workload with long prefixes? that's where kvcache matters most. also add continuous batching on/off toggle.

maria: good call. added continuous_batch=[true,false]. updated job config: 
```yaml
job: kv-batch-matrix-1865432199
samples: 2000
steady_state_minutes: 30
variants:
  - fp8
  - int8-gptq
  - awq
  - fp32-baseline
matrix_dimensions:
  - batch_size: [1,4,8,16]
  - kvcache_prefix: [0,32,128]
  - prefetch_ttl_ms: [0,50,200]
  - continuous_batch: [true,false]
workloads: [chat, web-search]
output_s3: s3://redwood-ml/experiments/kv-batch/1865432199/
```

elaine: pinging infra for GPUs. how long do you need?

maria: two 4-hour waves to start (so we can iterate quickly), then extend if anything surprising.

ops-bot: Started job kv-batch-matrix-1865432199 (job-id: jb-30921). Estimated run time: 4h per wave.

tony: quick question: for int8/gptq we should keep kv cache hashing consistent across quant variants so cache keys match. add config flag `normalize_kv_hash: true`?

maria: yes, normalizing enabled. also set `cache_validation_mode: strict` for first wave to detect silent cache misses.

hera: FYI previously saw a +1.7% QA regression on AWQ at batch=8 when prefix=32 in internal evals. might want to profile alignment errors.

maria: noted. we'll add a focused micro-run for that cell with debug traces.

ops-bot: Job jb-30921: wave-1 started on prow-node gpu-42. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/jb-30921/wave-1/logs

tony: capturing metrics to `prometheus/exp.kv_batch.1865432199`. please add tags: variant, batch_size, prefix, ttl, continuous.

maria: done. also pushing an eval harness that computes exact EM/ROUGE and a syntactic-safety delta for chat prompts. script: `tools/eval/kv_batch_eval.py --s3 s3://redwood-ml/experiments/kv-batch/1865432199`

elaine: infra note: wave-1 running on A10s, wave-2 scheduled on H100s (for fp8 throughput comparison).

sanjay: any early signals?

maria: first 500 samples for chat done. quick summary:
- fp32-baseline: EM=0.86
- fp8: EM=0.845 (delta -0.015)
- int8-gptq: EM=0.838 (delta -0.022)
- awq: EM=0.861 (delta +0.001)
latency (p95) at batch=4, prefix=32, continuous=true:
- fp32: 140ms
- fp8: 118ms
- int8-gptq: 105ms
- awq: 110ms
cost proxy (tokens/sec normalized): fp8 > int8-gptq > awq > fp32.

tony: interesting awq matches baseline accuracy but int8 shows larger drop. do we have quantization config parity? maybe AWQ is per-channel quantized while our int8-gptq uses per-tensor?

maria: int8-gptq used GPTQ defaults (per-tensor). i'll re-run int8 with per-channel config and note.

hera: also check KV cache interaction: are we writing cached KV in quantized format or unquantized? that can create mismatch when reusing cache across variants.

maria: currently cache stores raw fp16 kv. quantized variants decompress before exec. that should keep semantics, but I'll enable a trace that compares recomputed kv vs cached for a sample subset.

ops-bot: Job jb-30921: wave-1 partial results uploaded to s3://redwood-ml/experiments/kv-batch/1865432199/wave-1-summary.json

tony: can we add a short A/B test in Dedicated infra to validate production routing behavior? small traffic spike to see tail latency under real load.

elaine: schedule pending, but we'll need customer-safe tag.

maria: plan for wave-2: run int8-gptq with per-channel, enable `kv_recompute_check=true` for 100 samples, and run continuous_batch=false for the top-3 mismatch cells. will update job config and rerun.

sanjay: also add eval for hallucination rate — use the similarity-based filter. last time int8 looked fine on EM but hallucination increased.

maria: added hallucination metric. next update when wave-2 results land. thanks all :thumbsup:

hera: thanks, appreciate the quick triage.

ops-bot: Job jb-30921: wave-1 completed (gpu-42). artifacts: s3://redwood-ml/experiments/kv-batch/1865432199/wave-1/

maria: uploaded a short notebook with visualizations: s3://redwood-ml/experiments/kv-batch/1865432199/analysis/notebook.html

tony: grabbing that now. if awq continues to look good we should consider it for Dedicated default profile for chat workloads.

maria: agreed — will include a recommendation section in the final writeup.
